carousels.title: Your family's health lives in seven places

slides.text: YOUR FAMILY'S HEALTH LIVES IN SEVEN PLACES.
I've spent nine years marketing luxury homes, hotels and brands across India and the UAE. Every buyer I meet in Mumbai now asks about the same thing first. Health.
Indians live 70.8 years on average. 60.3 of them in good health.
slides.source: WHO, World Health Statistics 2021. India, 2019 data.

slides.text: That's about ten years where the body needs help. And in Mumbai, that help is scattered across the city.

An air purifier in every room.
A water filter under the sink.
A gym membership across town.
A physio twice a week, in traffic.
Blood tests at a lab in Andheri.
A sauna at a spa, by appointment.
Sleep from a white-noise app.
Seven places. Seven subscriptions. And the family does the coordinating, while the home, the most expensive thing they own, just sits there.
So I was just thinking about what happens when the building does the coordinating.

One home. Every system built in. Filtered air and water from one plant in the basement. Bedrooms built for deep sleep. A recovery suite and a movement studio downstairs. A clinic on the fifth floor. One health record for every family.
That's a longevity home. It protects the ten years in between. It's designed, run and serviced as one building, so it keeps protecting them.
I'M BUILDING THE FIRST ONE BETWEEN JUHU AND BANDRA WEST. DM ME IF YOU WANT TO BE IN THE ROOM.

carousels.title: Ten things built into a longevity home

slides.text: TEN THINGS BUILT INTO A LONGEVITY HOME.

slides.label: 01 Air
slides.text: Filtered fresh air in every room, with PM2.5 and CO2 on a screen.

slides.label: 02 Water
slides.text: Whole-home micro-filtration. Drinking grade at every kitchen tap.

slides.label: 03 Light
slides.text: Daylight first. Circadian lighting after dark. Full blackout for sleep.

slides.label: 04 Sound
slides.text: Acoustic glazing against the flight path and the traffic. Quiet bedroom zoning.

slides.label: 05 Materials
slides.text: Low-emission paints, glues and finishes, built to resist monsoon damp.

slides.label: 06 Amenities
slides.text: A recovery suite, a movement studio, a partner clinic and a sky garden.

slides.label: 07 Care
slides.text: Annual diagnostics, longevity protocols and a health dashboard for each family.

slides.label: 08 Ageing
slides.text: Step-free floors, wide doors and grab-ready walls, for three generations.

slides.label: 09 Upkeep
slides.text: Sensors and filters monitored and serviced on schedule, from day one.

slides.label: 10 Price
slides.text: 10 to 20% above the market. Nearly 70% of Mumbai's HNI buyers say they'll pay it.
ALL TEN ARE DESIGNED IN BEFORE THE FIRST SLAB IS CAST. DM ME FOR THE FULL PLAN.

carousels.title: The land is paid for in homes

slides.text: THE LAND IS PAID FOR IN HOMES.
Everyone who hears this idea asks me the same thing first. Where half an acre between Juhu and Bandra West comes from.
A 1,820 sq m plot in Juhu sold for INR 455 crore in December 2024. That's about INR 2.3 lakh per square foot of land.
At an FSI of 3, that's roughly INR 97,000 per square foot of saleable home, before a single brick. New Juhu launches ask INR 65,000 to 90,000.
So buying land outright on the western side rarely works today. The land has to be paid for in homes.
The plan is a society redevelopment. An older society on 1,500 to 2,500 sq m, on a 12 to 18 m road, within about a kilometre of the sea.
The society's 24 families get new homes 35% larger than their old ones, rent for the four years we build, and a corpus.
15 new homes of 1,800 to 2,400 sq ft go on sale. Three and four bedrooms, and one duplex penthouse.
On a 2,000 sq m plot that's about INR 241 crore of sales and about INR 74 crore of profit, on about INR 46 crore of partner cash before bookings start.
slides.source: Base case, plus or minus 15%. A real plot replaces every number.

slides.text: ONE SOCIETY. 39 HOMES. ONE ADDRESS THAT SETS THE PRICE FOR EVERY ONE AFTER IT.

carousels.title: The longevity layer pays for itself

slides.text: THE LONGEVITY LAYER PAYS FOR ITSELF FROM INR 75,400 A SQUARE FOOT.
Every investor I speak to asks me one thing about wellness homes. Whether buyers actually pay the premium. So here's the base case at three prices.
The longevity layer costs about 20% over a standard luxury build. On our 16-floor tower that's about INR 12.8 crore.
slides.source: ItaliaOggi, May 2026. InfraLens, Mumbai luxury tier, May 2026.

slides.label: INR 70,000 a sq ft. No premium.
slides.text: Profit about INR 48.8 crore. 23% of sales. The same building without the layer makes about INR 62 crore at this price.

slides.label: INR 80,000 a sq ft. A 14% premium.
slides.text: Profit about INR 73.7 crore. 31% of sales. This is the base case.

slides.label: INR 90,000 a sq ft. Where new Juhu launches sit.
slides.text: Profit about INR 98.7 crore. 36% of sales.
The layer pays for itself from about INR 75,400 a square foot. Everything above that is the category being born.
The whole build costs about INR 166.8 crore. Partners put in about INR 46 crore before bookings start. After RERA, buyers' payments held in escrow and a construction loan fund the rest.
Base case for a 2,000 sq m plot. Approximate, plus or minus 15%. A site feasibility on a real plot replaces every number here.
THE PREMIUM IS THE BUSINESS. DM ME FOR THE FULL MODEL.
SIXTEEN FLOORS. HALF AN ACRE. ONE PLANT IN THE BASEMENT.

slides.label: Basement
slides.text: A central fresh-air and water treatment plant. Every room in the building breathes and drinks from here.

slides.label: Ground
slides.text: An arrival garden with a reflecting pool, and a double-height lobby.

slides.label: Floors 1 to 4
slides.text: A parking podium for about 60 cars, with EV charging and full power backup.

slides.label: Floor 5
slides.text: The wellness level, about 2,600 sq ft. Cedar sauna, stone cold plunge, steam, a rain shower and a recovery lounge, open from 6 am, facing the sea. The partner clinic sits beside it.

slides.label: Floors 6 to 15
slides.text: 39 homes. 15 for sale, 24 for the society's families. Planted west-facing balconies and pale stone fins against the evening sun.

slides.label: Roof
slides.text: A sky garden with a lap pool and a sunset deck over the Arabian Sea.
The wellness level is free of FSI. Since May 2026, Mumbai allows 4% of built-up area for fitness, meditation and recreation outside FSI, up from 2%.
About 9,600 sq m of construction keeps the project under the 20,000 sq m line for state environmental clearance. About 16 floors keeps it inside the airport height limit.
EVERY FLOOR HAS A JOB. DM ME FOR THE FULL STACK.

carousels.title: Build the first one with us

slides.text: BUILD THE FIRST ONE WITH US.

slides.label: We bring
slides.text: The concept and the longevity standard. The brand and the product, from plan to finishes. The launch and the sales engine.

slides.label: We also bring
slides.text: Forty years of building luxury homes, through R1 Africa. Verona in Westlands, Nairobi. Rivera in Nanyuki. A wellness resort coming up at Vipingo.

slides.label: Capital partners
slides.text: Fund the first project. About INR 46 crore before bookings start, as a joint development, a licence per project or a revenue share, set site by site.

slides.label: Societies and landowners
slides.text: Bring the site. An older society of 1,500 to 2,500 sq m between Juhu and Bandra West, on a 12 to 18 m road, within about a kilometre of the sea.

slides.label: Clinic and design partners
slides.text: Run it and design it. Care, diagnostics and protocols from a clinic partner. The building and its homes from design partners.

slides.label: About 4 years 9 months
slides.text: Society agreement, months 0 to 6. Design and approvals, 6 to 15. Construction, 15 to 51. Handover, 51 to 57.

slides.label: Three risks, handled
slides.text: Consent takes time, so talks start with several societies at once. The premium is new, so the plan carries a 5% contingency. A clinic must earn its keep, so a partner runs it on a membership.
The first longevity address on the western side will set the price for every one after it.
